summary:
I fixed the five "doesn't work" bugs from the diagnosis in .handoff/fixreports/map-storefront-bug.json, with no redesign. Backend tsc and admin tsc are clean, and the 108 tests across the seven suites I ran all pass.

1. **Every admin DELETE failed with a 400 (fixed on the server).** I did not register a replacement JSON parser on the root, because that would stop the API booting. The webhook plugins (modules/webhooks/routes.ts:90 and modules/connectors/webhookRoutes.ts:37) add their own 'application/json' parsers. Fastify only allows that while the parent still has its built-in parser; a custom root parser makes them throw FST_ERR_CTP_ALREADY_PRESENT. Instead, the new backend/src/lib/jsonBody.ts adds an onRequest hook, registered in backend/src/index.ts next to the RLS hook. When a request says application/json but has no body (no Transfer-Encoding, Content-Length missing or 0), the hook drops the Content-Type, so Fastify runs the route with an undefined body. That is what Fastify already does for a body-less request with no Content-Type. Everything else is unchanged: malformed JSON still gets 400, proto-poisoning is still rejected, and the body size limit still gives 413. The webhook parsers keep working.

2. **The editor no longer goes blank when servd.pk is down.** The section list still comes only from the storefront host (NEXT_PUBLIC_STOREFRONT_URL, default https://servd.pk); there is no bundled copy.
   - In frontend/admin/src/lib/sections.ts, `useSectionCatalog({enabled})` now wraps any failure in a `SectionCatalogError`. Its message is the wording you asked for, naming the real host, plus a technical detail line. The query also sets `meta.inlineErrors`.
   - Builder.tsx: pop-ups never fetch the section list or wait for it. A page shows a panel with that message, the detail, a Retry button and links to Pop-ups and Library, instead of a blank screen.
   - ListPanels.tsx (Pages tab): shows the same message with Retry.
   - Providers.tsx: queries marked `meta.inlineErrors` no longer show the global toast. The network-failure toast now names only the API host: "Couldn't reach the servd API (host)…". The changes other agents had already made to this file are kept.

3. **hasDraft.** I added `DraftStatus` 'none' and `hasSavedDraft()` to frontend/admin/src/lib/content.ts.
   - Builder now uses `hasSavedDraft()`, so Discard is only clickable when there is a real draft or unsaved edits.
   - Submit on a page nobody has touched saves the draft first. Submit is disabled, with a hint, when the draft is pending or scheduled and nothing has changed.
   - Approve and Reject only appear when the draft is pending or scheduled. Approve is disabled while there are unsaved changes and no longer saves before approving, so the CEO approves exactly what was submitted.

4. **Marketing can now read its own brands.** In backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts, GET /concepts and GET /concepts/:id now:
   - give management the full row, as before;
   - give cashier and foh the till fields, as before (another agent's change, kept);
   - give any role whose effective modules include 'storefront' (by default marketing and brand_manager, and respecting moduleAllow/moduleDeny) only id, tenantId, name, slug, logoUrl, primaryColor and isActive, for active brands, scoped with `scopeTenantWhere(req,'read')`;
   - return 403 to every other role.

   includeInactive does not widen what Storefront roles see, and the write routes are unchanged.

5. **Upload storage.** /health now has `checks.uploadStorage`: it reports a warning, never an error, when R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or R2_PUBLIC_URL is unset, and lists which ones. In LibraryPanel.tsx:
   - The Library reads that check through the existing `fetchHealth()` in lib/connectorsApi.ts. When storage isn't configured it shows a clear amber banner and disables the upload button.
   - It also catches an upload URL the API signed with no R2 account (host undefined.r2…), cleans up the half-created file record, and shows the message once rather than once per file.
   - A failed upload to storage now says what probably went wrong: the bucket's CORS rules, or the HTTP status it got back.

The /health uploadStorage check has no automated test. It lives inline in index.ts, which can't be imported in a test, and I was only allowed to add jsonBody.ts as a new file. If you want it tested, it needs moving into a lib file.
tests:
The test database servd_test_sfquick was created. `npx vitest run` passed all 7 files and 108 tests: emptyJsonBody (9), storefrontQuickfix (12), storefrontContent (26), sepContent (30), auditTillUi (8), brandReconcile (18) and cors (5).

- **emptyJsonBody** covers: a body-less DELETE gets 204, or 404 when the route decides; Content-Length 0 and a charset parameter count as no body; normal JSON is parsed; malformed JSON gets 400 FST_ERR_CTP_INVALID_JSON_BODY; proto-poisoning gets 400; an oversize body gets 413; a child plugin with its own JSON parser still registers and gets the raw body.
- **storefrontQuickfix** covers two companies: marketing and brand_manager see their own company's active brands with the narrow fields only; the other company's and retired brands are excluded or 404; finance and a marketer with storefront denied get 403; management still gets the full row; marketing POST, PATCH and DELETE get 403. It also shows that without the hook, Discard draft gets 400 FST_ERR_CTP_EMPTY_JSON_BODY, with the hook it gets 204, and company B gets 404 on company A's draft.

`npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean in both backend and frontend/admin. No next build or dev server was run, and nothing was committed.
needsOtherFiles:
Optional follow-ups in files I was not allowed to edit:
(1) frontend/admin/src/lib/api.ts:193 should send Content-Type only when there is a body. The server now accepts it either way.
(2) backend/src/lib/storage.ts and the GET /media/upload-url route could refuse with 503 STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED when R2 isn't configured, instead of signing an upload URL for https://undefined.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. If that check were moved into a lib file, the /health check could be unit-tested.
Note: backend/src/modules/concepts/routes.ts and Providers.tsx already had other agents' uncommitted changes (FOH-01 till read access, UI-13 background meta). I kept them and built on them.
